name: Oria (Spain)
description: Green field quartered by a yellow cross, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Oria (a castle and a mountain on yellow and green).
history: Oria adopted its arms officially on 12 January 1982 and its flag on 18 February 2010; the flag is a rectangular green cloth of 2:3 quartered by a yellow cross whose arms are one fifth of the width of the cloth.

features.role: cross with arms one fifth of the width
